## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible effect of this change.

## Validation

List the exact local checks you ran. Do not claim GPU training, Oracle construction, or EPDMS scoring unless those
checks were actually completed in a correctly provisioned environment.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes tests or a clear explanation of why tests are not needed.
- [ ] Formatting, lint, and relevant tests pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog are updated when user-facing behavior changes.
- [ ] Existing third-party copyright and license headers are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, machine-specific paths, datasets, weights, or generated results are included.
- [ ] The manual seven-stage ordering and fixed handoff contract remain intact, unless this pull request explicitly
      documents an approved change to that public contract.
